title: Valve launches Steam Frame, its standalone VR headset with prices starting at 1,049 euros
summary: The device works without a PC thanks to a Snapdragon processor and bets on foveated streaming, although its high cost keeps it away from mass consumption.

title: Tech leaders and governments debate regulating superintelligence while Trump prioritizes the race against China
summary: Proposals such as Sanders' bill with 20-year prison sentences and expert warnings clash with the White House's stance of not slowing development.

title: Nvidia dominates the AI GPU market with the RTX 5090 and the new RTX PRO 5500 with 84 GB
summary: RTX 5090 scarcity drives its price up to $9,500 while the professional version prioritizes AI workloads over gaming.

title: Anthropic predicts AI will boost U.S. GDP by 32% but warns of massive job displacement
summary: The economic model estimates $44.4 trillion over four years, suggesting many workers will need to retrain for trades like electrician or nurse.

title: LG accused of recording conversations and scanning devices on its Smart TVs without clear consent
summary: Investigations reveal that the TVs collect location data and viewing habits, generating privacy complaints.

title: Hundreds of contractors hired by OpenAI read ChatGPT conversations to improve the model
summary: The 'Lily' project reveals that human employees access private chats, reigniting the debate over privacy in generative AI.
